scripts.codegen: npm run codegen:proto && npm run codegen:client-sdk && npm run codegen:native-data && npm run codegen:scenes && npm run codegen:client-handlers
scripts.build: npm run codegen && npm run typecheck && npm run build:ts && npm run build:client
scripts.build:debug: npm run codegen && npm run typecheck && npm run build:ts:debug && npm run build:client
scripts.test:native-data: npm run test:actor && cargo test --bin TiangZ native_data::tests
scripts.test:mailbox-parity: npm run build && npm run build:test:mailbox-parity && cargo build --bin TiangZ && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/mailbox_parity_test.ps1 -Mode both
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:protocol && npm run test:native-data && npm run test:scene-handler && npm run test:game-update && npm run test:movement-prediction && npm run test:map-broadcast && npm run test:logger && npm run test:player-persistence && npm run test:client-message && npm run test:client-sdk && npm run test:client-sdk-distribution && npm run typecheck:cocos-net && npm run typecheck:cocos-demo && npm run typecheck:pixi && npm run check:cocos-demo
scripts.verify:quick: npm run codegen && npm run verify:codegen && npm run verify:comments && npm run test:protocol-locks && npm run check && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets && cargo test --all-targets
scripts.test:watcher-graceful: npm run build && cargo build --bin TiangZ && node tools/watcher_graceful_self_test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run verify:quick && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:mailbox-parity && npm run test:backpressure && npm run test:watcher-graceful
scripts.test:runtime: npm run build && cargo build --bin TiangZ && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/smoke_runtime.ps1 -Mode both
scripts.perf:runtime: npm run build && npm run build:load && cargo build --release --bin TiangZ && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/runtime_load_test.ps1 -Release
scripts.perf:runtime:rust: npm run build && cargo build --release --bin TiangZ --bin runtime_load && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/runtime_load_test.ps1 -Release -Client rust -Connections 8 -Concurrency 1024
scripts.perf:inner-rpc: npm run build && cargo build --release --bin TiangZ --bin inner_rpc_load && node perf/inner_rpc/run_inner_rpc_perf.mjs
scripts.perf:full-chain: npm run build && npm run build:perf:full-chain && cargo build --release --bin TiangZ && node perf/full_chain/run_full_chain_perf.mjs
scripts.perf:soak: npm run build && npm run build:perf:full-chain && cargo build --release --bin TiangZ && node perf/soak/run_soak.mjs
scripts.perf:map-capacity: npm run build && npm run build:perf:full-chain && node perf/map_capacity/run_map_capacity_perf.mjs
scripts.perf:state-sync-full: npm run build && npm run build:perf:full-chain && node perf/map_capacity/run_map_capacity_perf.mjs --client rust --move-rate 0 --probe-rate 1 --state-sync-mode mixed --state-sync-rate 5
scripts.perf:full-chain:legacy: npm run build && npm run build:perf:full-chain && cargo build --release --bin TiangZ --bin runtime_load && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File perf/full_chain/run_full_chain_perf.ps1
scripts.test:backpressure: cargo test --bin TiangZ process::tests::bounded_process_queue_applies_backpressure && npm run build && npm run build:load && cargo build --bin TiangZ && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/runtime_load_test.ps1 -Config configs/local/bench_backpressure.json -Duration 2 -Warmup 1 -Concurrency 16384 -Connections 4 -Payload 256 -Delay 1
scripts.test:phase1.9: npm run check && cargo test --all-targets && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:backpressure
scripts.test:phase2.8.1: npm run check && cargo test --all-targets && npm run test:mailbox-parity && npm run test:runtime
scripts.test:inspector: npm run build:debug && cargo test --test inspector_debug -- --nocapture
